page.overview:
Who is Firefly?

The Firefly from this continuity is an accomplished sharpshooter, but, given his short appearance, it's unknown if he has the abilities of infiltration and explosives his original counterpart had.

Firefly shoots a missile to the UN building. The missile contained an advanced comm system that allowed Cobra Commander to make his point to all present.
